intent.raw: Execute every available SWU and refresh everything at the end.
intent.objective: Prove the live executable frontier is exhausted, then propose the exact planning and Craft transition from the fresh current-generation A1 pass to A2-only selection.
intent.operator_sentence: Pick all available SWUs, execute them sequentially, and refresh at the frontier.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The proposal is a deterministic sequential synthesis over shared planning and Craft targets.
subagent_strategy.explanation: No independent or parallel owner work is needed; proposal-only authoring is local and bounded.
context: All proposed targets share one synchronization boundary.

boundaries.contract: The fresh A1 pass may resolve its fixture-drift gate and open A2 planning only; it cannot execute A2 or change independent authority states.

boundaries.to_owner: private IOLM planning and Craft owner
boundaries.contract: Proposal-only evidence does not authorize target mutation; apply requires the exact invoke:refresh:apply-approved tuple.
A2 becomes executable only after the proposed synchronization is separately approved, applied and validated; A3 and A4 remain gated.

authority.lifecycle: Invoke Refresh owns proposal authoring; private IOLM planning/Craft owner owns any later apply.
authority.execution: Task Session owns one selected SWU after applied synchronization.
authority.validation: Context Builder, Dispatch Spec, syntax, selection and boundary checks.
authority.evidence: Fresh A1 result and receipt plus live target baselines.
authority.memory: Inventory is a non-authority lookup only.
authority.promotion: DomainSpec, CAV2 authority, public Arcanum, promotion and publication owners remain separate.

state_namespaces.owner: A2 Task Session after applied selection

promotion_splits.source: fresh A1 receipt and proposed A2 selection
promotion_splits.rule: The six-value ineligibility fence and independent owner gates are unchanged.

steps.name: Select strict frontier, receipt and target context

inputs.ref: operator batch request plus live IOLM frontier

stop_conditions: block if source receipt or target inventory is incomplete
block if any boundary obligation is uncovered

steps.name: Resolve the private IOLM target inventory

outputs.ref: twelve-target private IOLM planning and Craft inventory

stop_conditions: block if index.json is absent or unparsable
block if Inventory is treated as authority

steps.name: Propose the current A1 pass to A2-only transition
stop_conditions: block if proposal selects more than A2
block if proposal changes unrelated blockers or authority
block if proposal is represented as applied

steps.name: Validate proposal shape and owner boundary
stop_conditions: block on schema, syntax, source-hash or target-baseline drift
block if any target file changes during proposal-only validation

gates.condition: All ten obligations are covered by selector-bound sources.
Fresh A1 result and validation pass with iolm-fixture-boundary/v1.
Proposal completes A1, selects A2 only and preserves A3/A4 gates.
No target mutation occurs until exact invoke:refresh:apply-approved authorization is supplied.
No implementation, source, historical, authority or public state changes.
Dispatch, JSON, source hashes, baseline hashes and proposal-only diff boundary pass.

promotion_guardrails: Proposal completion is not apply authorization or A2 execution authority.
No fresh A1 or proposed A2 receipt can satisfy 00C-B, 00C-C, G-DSV2-SG, CROSS_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED, promotion or publication.
